ns2:course.label: Performance in Grad Thesis II
ns2:course.description: Performance laboratory involving the rehearsal and performance of student works under faculty supervision performed in MFA Thesis concert. .5 to 3 undergraduate hours. .5 to 3 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
